title: 第360章 梅比斯的战斗第361章 爆炸吧
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: “寒冰沼泽。”
布隆石脚下突然出现大片的水流。
紧接着，这些水流形成漩涡，已经覆盖了他的小腿。
卡拉的身影在布隆石身后悄然显现，
手中一张冰系卡牌按在地面。
冰属性源力顺着地面蔓延，瞬间便将布隆石的小腿冻结成冰。
冰层不断加厚，牢牢固定在原地，连一丝晃动都变得艰难。
“可恶的寒冰！”
布隆石怒吼着举起熔岩巨锤，锤身的岩浆纹路亮到极致。
大片大片的岩浆在他周身落下，身上的寒冰也快速的在消融。
“公主殿下！”
卡拉大喊一声，咬牙加大源力输出。
手中卡牌光芒更盛，更多的寒冰从地面涌出，死死压制着布隆石的熔岩，不让他彻底挣脱。
艾莎也是趁着布隆石被牵制，再次掷出一张卡牌。
寒翼妖灵仰头发出一声尖锐的妖鸣，双翼张开，极致的寒气从它体内爆发，整片天空瞬间被冰蓝色覆盖。
布隆石周身刚刚燃起的火焰，以肉眼可见的速度熄灭。
原本喷涌而出的岩浆，被这极致寒气强行冻结成漆黑坚硬的岩石，就连他脚下的地面，也迅速覆盖上一层厚厚的坚冰，将他的身影牢牢困住。
“怎么会有这么恐怖的力量？”
布隆石瞳孔骤缩。
此前他曾击退过无数外来者，可从未有一人拥有如此强悍的力量。
尤其是这冰属性力量，更是死死克制他的熔岩之力，让他浑身的力量都难以顺畅运转。
“领主级矮人，你的实力的确不错，在土著里算得上顶尖。”
艾莎身形一闪，从寒翼妖灵背上轻盈跃下。
周身的冰属性源力凝聚成一柄数丈长的冰之长枪，直刺布隆石的胸膛。
“但在我面前，你不过是块会发热的石头罢了，不堪一击。”
布隆石心脏狂跳，生死关头，他猛地回过神来，急忙横起熔岩巨锤，挡在自己胸前。
冰之长枪狠狠撞在熔岩巨锤上，
一股恐怖的气浪以二人为中心轰然炸开，地面的坚冰瞬间碎裂成无数碎片，四处飞溅。
“轰隆。”
布隆石脚下的冰层被这股冲击打破，整个人被震得连连后退，手臂被寒气侵入，泛起一层白霜。
火属性的他，本就被冰属性克制，尤其是同时面对两个配合默契御卡宗师，等待他的仿佛只剩下败局。
“首领！”
就在这危急时刻，一道道燃烧的箭矢从矮人村内呼啸而出，精准射向寒翼妖灵和艾莎，硬生生将二人逼退了数步。
“一群废物！”
艾莎面色一变，当即拉开距离。
这群矮人竟然敢出来支援，那就说明，她派去潜入村庄屠戮的人已经失败了。
只见一众矮人弓箭手手持火焰长弓，气势汹汹地冲了出来。
梅比斯被众矮人层层保护在中间，小小的身影此刻也没了以往胆小怕死的模样。
“布隆石，你没事吧？”
灵愈者？
布隆石面色骤变，心中一紧，厉声呵斥：“谁让你们出来的？快把灵愈者大人送回去！”
灵愈者是所有善良类人族的保护对象，布隆石哪怕自己战死，也绝对不能让灵愈者受到伤害。
content_en:
"Ice Swamp."
A large flow of water suddenly appeared at the foot of Bloemstone.
Immediately afterwards, the water flow formed a whirlpool and covered his calves.
Kara's figure quietly appeared behind Blonstone,
An ice card in his hand was pressed on the ground.
The ice attribute power spread along the ground and instantly froze Blomstone's calves into ice.
The ice layer continued to thicken and was firmly fixed in place, making it difficult to even move.
"Damn the ice!"
Blunstone roared and raised the giant lava hammer, the magma lines on the hammer's body shining brightly.
Large swaths of magma fell around him, and the ice on his body was melting rapidly.
"Your Highness the Princess!"
Kara yelled, gritted her teeth and increased her power output.
The card in his hand glowed brighter, and more ice surged out from the ground, suppressing Bronstone's lava, preventing him from completely breaking free.
Aisha also took advantage of Bloonstone being restrained and threw a card again.
"Hiss~"
The cold-winged demon spirit raised its head and let out a sharp scream, spread its wings, and the extreme cold air burst out from its body, and the entire sky was instantly covered with ice blue.
The flames that had just been ignited around Bloemstone were extinguished at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The magma that originally spewed out was forcibly frozen into dark and hard rock by the extreme cold air. Even the ground under his feet was quickly covered with a thick layer of ice, trapping his figure.
"How can it have such terrifying power?"
Bronze's pupils shrank suddenly.
He had fought off countless outsiders before, but never had anyone possessed such power.
In particular, this ice attribute power restrained his lava power, making it difficult for all his power to operate smoothly.
"Lord-level dwarf, your strength is indeed good, and you are considered the best among the natives."
Aisha's figure flashed and she jumped lightly from the back of the cold-winged demon spirit.
The ice attribute power all over his body condensed into an ice spear several feet long, which pierced Blomstone's chest.
"But in front of me, you are just a hot stone, vulnerable."
Blonstone's heart was beating wildly. At the critical moment of life and death, he suddenly came to his senses and hurriedly raised the lava hammer to block his chest.
"Bang."
The ice spear slammed into the lava hammer,
A terrifying wave of air exploded with the two people in the center, and the solid ice on the ground instantly shattered into countless fragments, flying everywhere.
"Boom."
The ice layer under Bronshi's feet was broken by the impact, and his whole body was shocked back. His arms were invaded by the cold air and covered with a layer of white frost.
As a fire attribute, he was originally restrained by the ice attribute. Especially when facing two card-controlling masters who cooperated tacitly at the same time, it seemed that all that was waiting for him was defeat.
"Chief!"
At this critical moment, flaming arrows roared out from the dwarf village and accurately shot at the Cold Wing Demon Spirit and Aisha, forcefully forcing the two back a few steps.
"A bunch of trash!"
Aisha's expression changed and she immediately distanced herself.
This group of dwarves dared to come out to support, which meant that the people she sent to sneak into the village and kill them had failed.
I saw a group of dwarf archers holding flaming long bows and rushing out menacingly.
Mavis was protected by layers of dwarves in the middle. The little figure no longer looked timid and fearful of death in the past.
"Blonstone, are you okay?"
A spiritual healer?
Bronshi's expression suddenly changed, his heart tightened, and he shouted sternly: "Who asked you to come out? Send the Lord Spiritual Healer back quickly!"
Spiritual healers are the protection objects of all kind-hearted humanoids. Even if Bronshi dies in battle, he must not let spiritual healers be harmed.
